Patient_Actor.history: A 32-year-old man presents to the clinic with a dull low back pain radiating to the buttocks. He first noted it about 2 years ago and it has; progressed since then. He notes that it is worse in the morning and improves later in the day after physical activity. The patient also reports morning stiffness lasting up to 30 minutes and blurred vision, which started about 7 months ago. The patient’s vital signs include: blood pressure 130/80 mm Hg, heart rate 88/min, respiratory rate 16/min, and temperature 36.8°C (98.2°F).
